traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Identity meets power and intensity. A magnetic, high-voltage presence that others react to immediately. The trine makes this a natural strength: Strength and depth, well-controlled. A natural aptitude for investigation, healing, and transformation. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Selfhood and power flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what selfhood and power have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Real influence; the intensity tends to polarize people.
shadow: The ease lets egotism and needing to be the center and control and obsession go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.
base: A pattern can become easier to change once its cost is understood well enough that another round of negotiation no longer adds anything useful.

readerCopy.body: A pattern can become easier to change once its cost is understood well enough that another round of negotiation no longer adds anything useful. When the Sun trines Pluto, purpose and power reinforce each other, making a habit, attachment, fear, or controlling dynamic easier to confront without turning the change into a dramatic reinvention. The strongest decision removes unnecessary power from the pattern. Confidence grows differently when the condition changes instead of merely being survived again.
